meaning: A basic musical note used in Carnatic music. Seven basic swaras: Sa, Ri, Ga, Ma, Pa, Da, Ni; Ri, Ga, Ma, Da, Ni have variants.
Reference pitch of a performance, commonly Sa. Software must work with relative pitch.
Melodic framework with characteristic note usage, movements, phrases and grammar; more than a scale.
Ascending movement/note framework of a raga.
Descending movement/note framework of a raga.
Characteristic phrase or note movement associated with a raga.
Characteristic ornamentation or movement around/between notes.
Major composed form with pallavi, anupallavi and charanam.
Structured composition for learning, practice and performance containing characteristic raga and tala material.
Rhythmically prominent composition, often late in a concert.
Raga elaboration section, rhythmic melodic improvisation.
Improvised exploration of a raga without fixed lyric structure.
Improvisation around a selected line while retaining text and framework.
Improvised swara passages within raga and tala.
Shift of tonal reference to another swara and examining the resulting scale/raga.
Characteristic melodic feel/expressive identity of a raga.
